messages:
tara: Heads-up: customer reported ~1.2k missing token events. Tracing -> fanout returned 429s and we currently drop.
ben: Not good. We need an auditable fix. Options: ephemeral spill, durable retry queue, or tombstone emission.
kai: Leaning ephemeral spill into compact-store with TTL (5m) then drain. If TTL expires emit tombstone so reconciler knows it was lost.
tara: Requirements: bounded storage, dedupe by event_id, per-tenant cap, metrics + alerting.
ben: Billing writer must dedupe on event_id and accept replay flag. Reconciler should not synthesize charges for tombstoned events.
kai: Implementation sketch: key=spill:${tenant}:${event_id}, value=raw envelope+meta, TTL=5m, drain consumer group with per-tenant rate limit. Cap=50k events/tenant -> start tombstoning oldest when exceeded.
tara: Ops: metrics spill.enqueue, spill.drain, spill.expire, per-tenant backlog. Playbook: increase drain workers, then notify CS if tombstones spike.
ops-bot: deploy-check: no recent deploys to fanout; compact-store TTL tests passing.
ben: Action items: @kai prototype, @tara dashboards/alerts, @ben write short RFC. Sync tomorrow 9am? :thumbsup:
tara: Thanks all. Start pilot on internal tenants first.
